# W3Schools

> > The world's largest web development learning platform offering free tutorials, references, and exercises in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, SQL, and dozens of other programming languages and frameworks.

W3Schools provides interactive learning through hands-on code editors, practice exercises, and certification programs. The platform covers frontend technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Bootstrap), backend languages (Python, PHP, Node.js, Java, C, C++, C#), databases (SQL, MySQL, MongoDB), and developer tools (Git).

## Key Topics

- HTML
- CSS
- JavaScript
- Python
- SQL
- Git
- React
- Node.js
- Bootstrap
- jQuery
- PHP
- Java
- MongoDB
- MySQL
- Web Development
- Frontend Development
- Programming Tutorials
- Interactive Code Editor
- Certification Programs

## Getting Started

- [W3Schools Online Web Tutorials](https://w3schools.com): Homepage offering free tutorials in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python & more
- [Tutorials - Free Web Development and Programming Tutorials](https://w3schools.com/tutorials/index.php): Complete catalog of programming tutorials from HTML to AWS
- [W3Schools Online Code Editor - Tryit Yourself](https://w3schools.com/tryit): Interactive code editor for testing HTML, CSS, JavaScript & more
- [W3Schools Exercises](https://w3schools.com/exercises): Practice exercises for HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, SQL & more
- [About W3Schools](https://w3schools.com/about/default.asp): Company info about W3Schools learning platform and services

## Web Development Fundamentals

- [HTML Tutorial](https://w3schools.com/html): Comprehensive HTML tutorial covering markup language fundamentals
- [Introduction to HTML](https://w3schools.com/html/html_intro.asp): HTML basics and introduction to markup language fundamentals
- [HTML and CSS Tutorial](https://w3schools.com/htmlcss/default.asp): Combined HTML and CSS tutorial for frontend web development
- [Web Development](https://w3schools.com/whatis): Overview of web development concepts including frontend and backend

## Programming Languages

- [Python Tutorial](https://w3schools.com/python): Complete Python programming tutorial from basics to advanced
- [C Tutorial](https://w3schools.com/c): C programming tutorial covering variables, pointers, and structures
- [Introduction to Programming](https://w3schools.com/programming/index.php): Programming fundamentals and basic concepts with examples

## Developer Tools & Version Control

- [Git Tutorial](https://w3schools.com/git/default.asp): Git version control tutorial with GitHub, GitLab integration
- [Learn Git — W3Schools.com](https://campus.w3schools.com/products/learn-git): Git course with certification exam and Hero plan subscription

## Reference Documentation

- [HTML Reference](https://w3schools.com/TAGs): Complete HTML tags and elements reference documentation

## How-To Guides & Examples

- [How To Create an Accordion](https://w3schools.com/howto/howto_js_accordion.asp): JavaScript tutorial for building collapsible accordion UI components
- [How To Create an About Page](https://w3schools.com/howto/howto_css_about_page.asp): CSS tutorial for creating responsive about page layouts
- [How To Clear Floats (Clearfix)](https://w3schools.com/howto/howto_css_clearfix.asp): CSS clearfix hack tutorial for fixing float layout issues

## Optional

- [FAQ - W3Schools Bootcamps](https://w3schools.com/bootcamp/faq.php): Bootcamp FAQ covering admission, schedule, payment, and certificates
- [HTML VIDEOS](https://videos-stage.w3schools.com): Paid HTML video course with 22 chapters covering elements to forms
- [Python Comments](https://w3schools.com/python/python_comments.asp): Python tutorial page explaining comment syntax and documentation
